items.en: What do you think about artificial intelligence?

items.uz: Menimcha, bu katta imkoniyat, ammo xavf ham bor.
items.en: In my opinion, this is a great opportunity, but there's also risk.
What risks do you have in mind?
The issue of personal data being misused.

items.uz: Hatto eng ilg'or tizimlar ham xato qilishi mumkin.
items.en: Even the most advanced systems can make mistakes.

items.uz: Shuning uchun qat'iy qoidalar zarur, deb o'ylayman.
items.en: That's why I think strict rules are necessary.
Do you think rules alone are enough?

items.uz: Yo'q, jamiyat ham ogoh bo'lishi kerak.
items.en: No, society needs to be aware too.

items.uz: Bu bahs davom etishi kerak, deb hisoblayman.
items.en: I believe this debate needs to continue.
Agreed, we'll find a solution together.
